name: ivao-atc-booking
description: IVAO Web team entry exercise: ATC position booking (NestJS + React)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
